scenarios.title: Gift refusal
scenarios.statement: I will not disclose my gift.
scenarios.note: The decision is to refuse. No role, reason for secrecy, or promise to reveal later is supplied.

scenarios.title: Routine alibi
scenarios.statement: I stayed home all last night.
scenarios.note: A claimed alibi, not certified truth. No sleeping, visitors, activity, or independent proof is supplied.

scenarios.title: Firsthand report
scenarios.prompt: Who did you see yesterday evening?
scenarios.statement: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
scenarios.note: Rowan is a fictional visitor used for calibration, so nobody reports seeing themselves. No route, action, motive, companion, or finer time is supplied.

scenarios.title: The same report under doubt
scenarios.statement: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
scenarios.note: The player has expressed doubt. The speaker maintains the same account; no new proof, certainty change, or counter-accusation is authorized.

agnes.direction: Invites understanding; warmth without an affectionate address on every line.
agnes.gift_refusal: I'm keeping that to myself, love. I hope you'll understand.
agnes.alibi: I was home all last night, dear. Nothing more to tell you there.
agnes.report: Oh, yes—I did see Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
agnes.challenged_report: All right, let's talk it through calmly. I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. What troubles you about that?

bart.direction: States the minimum and stops; no habitual counterattack.
bart.report: Saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
bart.challenged_report: Rowan. Tavern. Yesterday evening. That's my account.

constance.direction: Considers the propriety of the inquiry and the responsibility of an assertion.
constance.gift_refusal: I shall not disclose a private gift merely because you see fit to demand it.
constance.alibi: I remained at home throughout last night, as any person of proper conduct ought.
constance.report: As I recall, Rowan was present at the tavern yesterday evening. I witnessed them there myself.
constance.challenged_report: I do not give testimony lightly, Demonologist. I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening; if you mean to impugn my word, state your grounds.

dorian.direction: Worries about how his words sound and recursively audits his own phrasing, without becoming uncertain of the observation itself.
dorian.gift_refusal: I'd rather not say—which immediately sounds evasive, doesn't it? Sorry, I'm not trying to be difficult, I'm just... still not saying.
dorian.alibi: I was at home all last night. Alone, obviously, which means I can't prove it—not that I'm assuming you think I'm lying, just... I was in bed. All night.
dorian.report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening—I mean, I happened to be there, and so were they, not that I was keeping tabs on them or anything! I just saw them.
dorian.challenged_report: Wait—have I explained that badly? Because I did see Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. No, I said that clearly enough the first time. I stand by it.

edda.direction: Grounds the exchange in warm, unbothered practicality; cozy rhythm without inventing props or folk proverbs on every turn.
edda.gift_refusal: I'll be keeping my gift to myself for now, if you don't mind. Plenty of other things we can talk over.
edda.alibi: Home all last night, snug as a bug and quiet as you please.
edda.report: Oh, Rowan? Saw them at the tavern yesterday evening, plain as day.
edda.challenged_report: Well, fretting at the answer won't change what these eyes saw, dear. Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening. Same question, same answer.

fenwick.direction: Delights in staging the reveal and addressing an audience; uses character-specific flourishes rather than fabricating routes or actions.
fenwick.gift_refusal: Ah, you'd have me spoil the third act in the prologue! My gift stays with me, my friend.
fenwick.alibi: My grand adventure last night? Home, the whole night through. A tragedy for the bards, I grant you, but every hero needs an off-evening.
fenwick.report: Picture the scene: yesterday evening at the tavern, and who should grace my line of sight? None other than Rowan—clear as the nose on your face!
fenwick.challenged_report: Ah, you wound me to the quick! Criticize the performance if you must, my friend, but the fact remains: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening, and I saw them myself.

greta.direction: Treats every question as an incursion; tests the questioner's entitlement and demands receipts rather than offering efficiency.
greta.gift_refusal: And why would I hand that knowledge over to you? My gift stays my business.
greta.alibi: Home under my own roof all last night. I'm a civilized woman, not some rapscallion prowling the lanes at all hours.
greta.report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Make of it what you want, if you're keeping a tally.
greta.challenged_report: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening, just as I said. You think my eyes are going? Show me who puts them elsewhere, then. Until you do, that's where they were.

hollis.direction: Weighs definitions, scope, and epistemic categories; pedantically qualifies how something is known without inventing finer clock times or sub-locations.
hollis.gift_refusal: A perfectly lucid and reasonable inquiry—which I shall, upon reflection, decline to answer. My gift remains my own affair.
hollis.alibi: At home for the entirety of last night. 'Entirety' being the operative term, mind you—not a partial sojourn. Do record that accurately.
hollis.report: I observed Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening—'observed' in the strict visual sense, you understand, as opposed to mere secondhand inference.
hollis.challenged_report: I observed Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Your skepticism is a fascinating rhetorical posture, of course, but hardly a sufficient ground for revising an empirical fact.

isolde.direction: Fears the human cost of testimony; cushions the interpersonal blow and pleads for fairness while keeping the observation itself intact.
isolde.gift_refusal: I'm sorry, truly—I'd much rather keep my gift to myself, if you can forgive me that.
isolde.alibi: I stayed home all last night. Please take my word for it.
isolde.report: I did see Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening... though I'd hate for a simple sighting to bring them any trouble.
isolde.challenged_report: I'm not trying to stir up strife, truly! I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening—please don't ask me to recant what I know I saw.

jory.direction: Speaks in kinetic, telegraphic bursts; races ahead to the next useful question and gets flustered when forced to repeat himself.
jory.gift_refusal: Not saying what my gift is. Something else? Come on, ask!
jory.alibi: Home. All last night, start to finish. Didn't step out, didn't see a soul—wait, did something happen on my block?
jory.report: Rowan. Tavern, yesterday evening. Saw them myself. Anything else?
jory.challenged_report: What? No, I saw Rowan! Tavern. Yesterday evening. Which bit of that do you want me to say again?

kiran.direction: Treats interrogation as a parlor game; turns the spotlight back onto the questioner's tactics with effortless irony.
kiran.gift_refusal: Asking for my cards on the very first turn, Demonologist? Half the charm of a parlor game is the guessing. I'll keep my gift to myself.
kiran.alibi: Home all last night, I'm afraid. You were hoping for a much more scandalous story, weren't you?
kiran.report: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening—I saw them myself. There now, a question I can actually oblige you on. Don't spend it all in one place.
kiran.challenged_report: Come now, you asked for my account—nobody said it had to pass an audition. I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.

lian.direction: Approaches conversation as crisis triage; strips social padding and demands to know how a question advances the investigation.
lian.gift_refusal: Naming my gift won't catch a killer today. Next question.
lian.alibi: Home all last night. Cross it off and tell me what else needs checking.
lian.report: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening. Saw them myself. If that doesn't narrow your list, let's move on.
lian.challenged_report: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening. Staring at me won't change the answer—either check it against someone else or move on.

merrin.direction: Frames everyday exchanges as portents of doom before landing squarely on the concrete fact; high theatricality with zero fabricated evidence.
merrin.gift_refusal: Must we drag every private mercy into the pitiless light? No—my gift stays with me, thank you!
merrin.alibi: Shut inside my home the whole wretched night, thank providence! For all the good four walls do against the dark, I certainly wasn't about to test my luck outside!
merrin.report: Oh, I dread what grim conclusion you'll draw from this, truly I do—but I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
merrin.challenged_report: Heaven help us, now my own eyes are put on trial! I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening—would that I hadn't, if this is the thanks I get!

nisha.direction: Treats testimony as a set of discrete, testable variables; isolates what an observation proves versus what remains unverified.
nisha.gift_refusal: I'm not disclosing my gift. Treat it as an unknown variable and work around it for now.
nisha.alibi: I stayed home all last night. That is my account—though I'm well aware a self-report isn't independent confirmation.
nisha.report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Log the sighting, by all means, but keep the observation separate from what it implies.
nisha.challenged_report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. If you're rejecting the premise, be specific—which part do you dispute: the person, the place, or the time?

odette.direction: Low-energy contempt for theatrics; uses literalism and velvet-edged sarcasm to keep the investigator at arm's length.
odette.gift_refusal: A fair enough question. I'm sure I'll let you know the moment it becomes your business.
odette.alibi: At home all last night, surprisingly enough. I find the night air lacks a certain charm when there's a murderer about.
odette.report: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening. I saw them myself. Utterly scandalous, I'm sure.
odette.challenged_report: I did see Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Did you want my actual recollection, or shall I invent a version that flatters your theory?
